examples.en: We appointed him as our representative.

examples.text: Ellos lo eligieron como su representante.
examples.en: They chose him as their representative.

examples.text: ¿Quién es el actual representante de Francia?
examples.en: Who is the current representative from France?

examples.text: Es un representante acreditado del gobierno canadiense.
examples.en: He's an accredited representative of the Canadian government.

examples.text: Tú eliges a tu representante votando.
examples.en: You elect your representative by voting.
